# Resources: Communities, moodboards and feeds

Cross-discipline sources for scanning and collecting. High volume, mixed signal: concept shots ignore real content, states and accessibility. Use for visual treatment and trend awareness, then verify against real products.

Access reads `cost · agent access · licence`. Agent access: `static` = a plain web fetch can read it; `js` = needs a real browser; `blocked` = bot protection or a login wall, send the user the link instead; `unknown` = could not be reached from the maintainer's network when last checked (not proof that it is down). `login` = content is gated. Tier: `S` first place to look, `A` strong, `B` niche or with a clear weakness.

## Communities

Read case-study process, not just covers.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Dribbble](https://dribbble.com) | Designer community of shots; strong for visual styling, weak for realism (content, states, accessibility) | Use for visual treatment ideas only; verify against real products | freemium · js | A |
| [Behance](https://www.behance.net) | Full project case studies across branding, illustration, UI and motion | Search by field and tool; read the process, not just the cover | free · static | A |
| [Layers](https://layers.to) | Smaller, higher-signal community for product designers | Find working designers' real projects | free · static | B |

## Moodboards and reference tools

Collect from outside the interface-design bubble.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Are.na](https://www.are.na) | Designer-run research boards with unusually thoughtful curation | Search channels for a concept; sources come from outside the design bubble | freemium · static | S |
| [Pinterest](https://www.pinterest.com) | Visual search engine for moodboarding across every discipline | Use visual search on a reference image to find relatives | free · js · login | A |
| [Cosmos](https://www.cosmos.so) | Ad-free visual bookmarking for creatives with strong aesthetic curation | Follow clusters for art-direction references | freemium · static · login | A |
| [Savee](https://savee.com) | Bookmarking feed used by graphic and art directors | Broad art-direction inspiration | free · static | A |
| [Same Energy](https://same.energy) | Visual search engine that finds images with the same feel | Start with one image, explore its neighbours | free · js · slow | A |
| [Eagle](https://eagle.cool) | Local asset manager for collecting and tagging references | Personal reference library | paid · static | A |
| [Designspiration](https://www.designspiration.com) | Inspiration search by keyword and colour | Find references matching a palette | free · static · slow | B |
| [PureRef](https://www.pureref.com) | Lightweight reference-board app | Keep references visible while working | freemium · js | B |
